en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2. Abi (rah) from Abdillah b. Ja’far from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Ahmad from his father [from] Abdillah b. Sinan from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
One who does not spit in mosque and swallows it, would soon be cured of the disease from which he is suffering.”
